prompt: Single continuous shot. Opens mid-action: a salmon fillet pressed skin-down into a screaming pan, an instant crackle, edges turning opaque as the skin crisps. The camera slides to a passion fruit sliced open and its golden pulp with black seeds spooned straight into a saucepan, bubbling down glossy. Money shot: cold butter cubes dropped one by one into the sauce OFF the heat, each swirl turning it more velvet, then the golden sauce poured over the crisp salmon in a slow ribbon that pools around it, seeds glinting, backlit steam. Final beat: a fork flaking the salmon open, coral layers steaming. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the skin crackle, then the sauce pour. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption:
Salmão com molho de maracujá aveludado — o truque é a manteiga fora do fogo, cubo a cubo
